_comment: DEMO DATA. Modelled on abuhuraira.org/programs (and its old-CMS feed) on 2026-10-02, in the snake_case shape Muslimoon uses elsewhere (/v1/<org>/announcement-bar, /services). Field names are a best guess until AHC publishes real programs; the app's normaliser also accepts camelCase and other aliases.

programs.name: Attabukiyyah
programs.short_description: Imam Ibn al-Qayyim’s Attabukiyyah: The Provision of the Traveller to his Lord.
programs.description: A weekly class with Sheikh Abdulmonem on Imam Ibn al-Qayyim’s Attabukiyyah (al-Risalah al-Tabukiyyah), “The Provision of the Traveller to his Lord.” The class takes its theme from the verse: “And take provisions, but indeed, the best provision is taqwa.” (Qur’an 2:197)
curriculum: The Provision of the Traveller to his Lord

programs.name: Sunday Halaqah: Al-Kalim at-Tayyib
programs.short_description: Al-Kalim at-Tayyib (The Goodly Word). Breakfast is provided after the halaqah.
programs.description: Start your Sunday with knowledge and remembrance. Sheikh Amar Abdiwali leads a weekly halaqah after Fajr on Al-Kalim at-Tayyib (The Goodly Word). Breakfast is provided after the gathering.

programs.name: The Complete Muslimah
programs.short_description: A comprehensive course with Sh. Musleh Khan on navigating identity, purpose and power through Islamic guidance.
programs.description: The Complete Muslimah is a comprehensive course with Sh. Musleh Khan that dives deep into divine roles in Islam, from the personal to the political. Together, sisters will explore identity, sacred practice, life transitions, modern identity, and practical answers for Muslim women today.

programs.name: Tafseer Surah Yusuf
programs.short_description: Practical lessons, timeless wisdom and Quranic guidance from Surah Yusuf with Sh. Musleh Khan.
programs.description: A journey through the most beautiful story in the Quran. Join Sh. Musleh Khan for in-depth tafsir, practical lessons, timeless wisdom, and Quranic guidance from Surah Yusuf.

curriculum_items.item: Applying the lessons of Surah Yusuf today

programs.name: Footsteps of the Chosen
programs.short_description: Reflecting on the lives of the Prophets and applying their guidance today.
programs.description: “They are those whom Allah has guided, so follow their guidance.” (Qur’an 6:90) This halaqah invites us to reflect on the lives of the Prophets (Nuh’s perseverance, Ibrahim’s sacrifice, Musa’s courage, Isa’s compassion, and the perfect character of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ) and apply their timeless guidance to our own struggles, choices, and aspirations.

programs.name: Iqra Evening Quran School
programs.short_description: Learn to read Arabic and recite the Quran with proper Tajweed. Ages 5+, boys and girls, in person and online.
programs.description: Iqra Evening Quran School focuses on reading Arabic, and how to recite the Quran with the proper Tajweed rules. Sessions happen twice a week, Mondays and Wednesdays or Tuesdays and Thursdays. Registration is required. Email iqra@abuhuraira.org for more information.
programs.age_group: Ages 5+ · Boys and girls · In person and online

programs.name: Girls Weekend Hifdh 2026
programs.short_description: Quran memorization and Tajweed for girls, with experienced female instructors.
programs.description: A nurturing and structured weekend program to help young girls memorize the Qur’an. With experienced female instructors and a supportive sisterhood, students build a strong connection with the Qur’an while developing discipline, focus, and love for the Book of Allah.

programs.name: AHC Weekend School
programs.short_description: Quran, Islamic Studies, Wudhu & Salah, and du’aa, plus field trips. SK to Grade 10.
programs.description: Weekend School focuses on reading Quran, Islamic Studies, Wudhu/Salah, and Duaa’s. Field trips and fun activities are also planned for the students to learn more about Islam and the community.
programs.age_group: SK to Grade 10 · Boys and girls

programs.name: Full Time Hifdh
programs.short_description: Learn and excel in the memorization of the Quran.
programs.description: Learn and excel in the memorization of the Quran in a full-time weekday program.

programs.name: Perfecting Your Salah
programs.short_description: Understand and correct common mistakes in Salah through real-life scenarios and authentic evidence.
programs.description: An interactive course on perfecting Salah, focusing on common mistakes in individual and congregational prayer, from the prerequisites of Salah to the Tasleem, with evidence from the Quran, Sunnah, and the scholarship of Islam.
curriculum: Common mistakes in individual and congregational prayer
